name: caveman
title_zh: 省 75% token 的穴居人语模式
tagline_zh: 长对话烧 token 烧到肉疼？切换成穴居人语，输出短一半还带技术术语。
tagline_en: Tired of burning tokens on verbose replies? Switch to caveman speak—short, technical, and still precise. Six.
desc_en: Ultra-compressed communication mode. Cuts token usage ~75% by speaking like caveman while keeping full technical accuracy. Supports intensity levels: lite, full (default), ultra, wenyan-lite, wenyan-full, wenyan-ultra. Use when user says "caveman mode", "talk like caveman", "use caveman", "less tokens", "be brief", or invokes /caveman. Also auto-triggers when token efficiency is requested.
why_zh: 不是简单删词，而是重构句式保留术语密度。默认 full 档平衡可读与压缩，文言文档连标点都省。
why_en: Not just word deletion—it restructures sentences while keeping term density. Default 'full' balances readability and.
limit_zh: 只压缩模型输出，不处理输入。若你的任务需要逐字精确措辞（如法律文书、诗歌翻译），压缩后可能丢语气，需人工校对。
limit_en: Compresses only model output, not input. For tasks needing verbatim precision (legal docs, poetry), tone may be lost—manual review required.
title_en: Caveman mode: cut tokens ~75%, keep technical accuracy
